SIGNALS.name: OpenAI
SIGNALS.summary: OpenAI says GPT-6 and Intelligent UI are rolling out in ChatGPT for everyone, giving more visual, interactive answers and on-the-spot tools for tasks.

SIGNALS.name: Liquid AI
SIGNALS.summary: Liquid AI releases Open d1, two open-weight multimodal models: d1-3B (text and vision) and d1-omni-600M (text with image or audio), for real-time decisions from data centers to edge devices.

SIGNALS.name: Anthropic
SIGNALS.summary: Anthropic expands its Cyber Verification Program so verified security professionals can use Claude Mythos 5.1, Opus 5.5 and Sonnet 5.5 with safeguards built for defensive work.

SIGNALS.name: Mistral AI
SIGNALS.summary: Mistral introduces Mistral Large 4, nicknamed Le Chonk: 1T parameters, natively multimodal, 49B active, which it calls the best open-weights model from the US or Europe on aggregated benchmarks.

SIGNALS.name: Reflection
SIGNALS.summary: Reflection introduces Beam, an open model with 501B total and 23B active parameters, trained from scratch. Full weights are due to be released this month.

SIGNALS.name: AGTP
SIGNALS.summary: Reports, citing Tibor Blaho, that OpenAI is rolling out invisible text watermarking for ChatGPT and Codex in the EU to meet AI Act text provenance rules.
